versions.content: The job of the function NvM_ReadAll shall load the ROM default data to the corresponding RAM blocks and set the error/statu s field in the Specification of NVRAM Manager AUTOSAR CP R19 - 11 119 of 197 Document ID 33 : AUTOSAR_SWS_NVRAMManager - AUTOSAR confidenti al - administrative block to NVM_REQ_OK when processing the extended runtime preparation.

The job of the function NvM_ReadAll shall restore the default data to the corresponding RAM blocks either if configured by the parameter NvMRomB lockDataAddress or by the parameter NvMInitBlockCallback, and set the Specification of NVRAM Manager AUTOSAR CP R20 - 11 119 of 202 Document ID 33 : AUTOSAR_SWS_NVRAMManager error/status field in the administrative block to NVM_REQ_RESTORED_DEFAULTS when processing the extended runtime preparation.

The job of the function NvM_ReadAll shall restore the default data to the corresponding RAM blocks either if configured by the parameter NvMRom BlockDataAddress or by the parameter NvMInitBlockCallback, and set the error/status field in the administrative block to NVM_REQ_RESTORED_DEFAULTS when process- ing the extended runtime preparation.

The job of the function NvM_ReadAll shall restore the default data to the corresponding RAM blocks either if configured by the parameter NvMRom BlockDataAddress or by the parameter NvMInitBlockCallback, and set the error/status field in the administrative block to NVM_REQ_RESTORED_DEFAULTS when process- ing the extended runtime preparation.
